notes: Paper derives NEW exclusion limits on axion decay constant f_a from black hole superradiance observations of solar-mass black holes (Cyg X-1, GRS 1915+105). The primary result is a constraint on the f_a-m_a plane (AxionMass coupling type) derived from the requirement that observed high-spin black holes would have been spun down by axion superradiance if axions were present. The analysis extends previous work by including higher-order superradiant states (n≤5) and relativistic corrections. Main limit shown in Fig. 1 (dark blue region) excludes f_a values roughly 1-2 orders of magnitude lower than previous analyses. The data_points are approximate extractions from Fig. 1 and represent rough boundaries of the excluded region; precise numerical values are not tabulated in the paper. The limit is mass-dependent, spanning roughly m_a ~ 10^-12 to 10^-9 eV with corresponding f_a constraints. Confidence level is 95% (2σ).
